title: finding(types,components): objectui#7759 group D date-value keys — `CalendarSchema.defaultValue` / `.value` cross the JSON/TS boundary: the mirror takes ISO strings or `Date` while the declaration says `Date`
body:
Execution split of objectstack-ai/objectui#7759, **group D, the date-value keys**. It follows ruling 5617221514 as adopted by the director (5617465269 and 5617614225), item D1-(iii): 「日期值键裁一次 JSON/TS 边界（镜像声明 ISO 串、声明保留 `Date`、渲染器补缺失的 coercion）」. Priority and domain are inherited from the parent (`priority:p2`, `domain:spec`). Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`. Siblings: group E is on the parent, objectui#10280 is group B, and objectui#10286 is the decidable C/D subset.

## The keys

| pair | keys | now | direction under D1-(iii) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form.zod.ts#CalendarSchema` (about `:534`) / `form.ts#CalendarSchema` (about `:1140`) | `defaultValue`, `value` | the mirror is `z.union([z.string(), z.date()])` and the declaration is `Date`, so the two faces are disjoint on the string arm | **the mirror declares the authoring type as an ISO date string** (JSON has no `Date`). **The declaration keeps `Date`** for TS authors and adds the ISO string the mirror accepts. **The renderer adds the missing string → `Date` coercion** at its read site, so an authored ISO string actually selects the day. |

The dev measures the read site (the `calendar` renderer in `packages/components`) before and after: an ISO string must select the same day as the equivalent `Date`. Watch for west-of-UTC day drift on date-only strings; objectui#10183 is the in-tree precedent for rendering a date-only value as the day it names.

## Done when

Both rows leave `WiderThanDeclared`, `WIDER_ARMS` and `KnownDrift`. A pin reddens on revert. A renderer test proves an ISO string selects the named day. There is one changeset (`minor` on `@object-ui/types`, plus `@object-ui/components` for the coercion). Clause-② yes.
